```{r}
# Load data
df_all <- read_csv("Data/merged_data_all.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) 

df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(
    hcv = replace_na(hcv, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Use the inclusion/exclusion flow flags from 01_merge_data when available
    included = if ("included_step1" %in% names(.)) coalesce(included_step1, FALSE) & !is.na(age) else (hcv == 1) & !is.na(fsm) & !is.na(age),
    cohort = if_else(included, "Included", "Excluded")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
      haz_alc = case_when(
      audit_c_score >= 4 & str_to_lower(gender) == "male" ~ "Hazardous (AUDIT-C)",
      audit_c_score >= 3 & str_to_lower(gender) != "male" ~ "Hazardous (AUDIT-C)",
      is.na(audit_c_score) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ "Not hazardous"
    ),
    obesity = case_when(
      is.na(bmi) ~ NA_character_,
      bmi >= 30 ~ "Obese (BMI ≥ 30)",
      bmi < 30 ~ "Not obese (BMI < 30)"
    ),
    aboriginal = if_else(
      aboriginal == "Indigenous", 1, 0
      )
  )

#Change names of studies
df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(
    study = case_when(
      study == "Simplify" ~ "SIMPLIFY",
      study == "Defeat" ~ "D3FEAT",
      study == "LiverLife" ~ "LIVERLIFE",
      study == "ETHOS" ~ "ETHOS Engage",
      study == "DARLO" ~ "DARLO-C",
      study == "POCT" ~ "Australian PoC Testing Program",
      study == "TEMPO-RCT" ~ "TEMPO",
      TRUE ~ study
    )
  )

#Total number of cases
df_all %>% count(study)

#Create inclusion/exclusion datasets
df_final <- df_all %>%
  filter(included)

df_excluded <- df_all %>%
  filter(!included)

#Sanity checks
df_all %>%
  count(cohort) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  print()

df_final %>%
  count(cirrhosis = fsm >= 12.5) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  print()

df_final %>%
  count(hcv)

df_final %>%
  count(fibro_valid)

df_all %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  count(hcv)

df_all %>%
  filter(hcv == 1) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  count(is.na(fsm))

df_all %>%
  filter(hcv == 1) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  count(fibro_valid)

# Age-stratified prevalence (included cohort)

```{r}
# Use the *included analytic cohort* (df_final) so denominators match Table 1
stopifnot(exists("df_final"))

age_bin_prev <- df_final %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(fsm)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_bin = cut(
      age,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 35, 40, 45, Inf),
      right = FALSE,
      labels = c("<35", "35-39", "40-44", "45+")
    ),
    fsm_12_5 = fsm >= 12.5,
    fsm_20 = fsm > 20
  ) %>%
  group_by(age_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cohort = n(),
    n_fsm_12_5 = sum(fsm_12_5),
    prev_fsm_12_5 = mean(fsm_12_5),
    n_fsm_20 = sum(fsm_20),
    prev_fsm_20 = mean(fsm_20),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

age_bin_prev

write_csv(age_bin_prev, "Results/Descriptives/Cohort_Prevalence_byAgeBin_included.csv")

cat(
  "Included cohort with non-missing age+FSM:",
  sum(age_bin_prev$n_cohort),
  "\n"
)

# Summary study level

```{r}
df_study <- read_csv("Data/study_data.csv")

# unweighted table = number of studies
tbl_studies <- df_study %>%
  select(
    `Study location` = study_location,
    `Study design` = study_design,
    `Included sample size` = sample_group,
    `Population included` = population_group
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    missing = "no",
    statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    digits = all_categorical() ~ c(0, 0),
    sort = list(
      `Study location` ~ "frequency",
      `Study design` ~ "frequency",
      `Included sample size` ~ "frequency",
      `Population included` ~ "frequency"
    )
  )

tbl_studies

```{r}
# Mosaic plot (area proportional to prevalence): age bins (35/40/45) x FSM bins (12.5/20)
df_mosaic <- df_final %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(fsm)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_bin = cut(
      age,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 35, 40, 45, Inf),
      right = FALSE,
      labels = c("<35", "35-39", "40-44", "45+")
    ),
    fsm_bin = cut(
      fsm,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 12.5, 20, Inf),
      right = FALSE,
      labels = c("<12.5", "12.5-19.9", "20+")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(age_bin, fsm_bin, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    age_bin,
    fsm_bin,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(age_bin) %>%
  mutate(age_total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    cohort_total = sum(n),
    prop_overall = if_else(cohort_total > 0, n / cohort_total, 0),
    prop_within_age = if_else(age_total > 0, n / age_total, 0)
  )

# Compute rectangle coordinates:
# - Age bin widths proportional to age_total
# - Within each age bin, FSM bin heights proportional to prop_within_age
df_age_widths <- df_mosaic %>%
  distinct(age_bin, age_total) %>%
  arrange(age_bin) %>%
  mutate(
    .denom = sum(age_total),
    x_width = if_else(.denom > 0, age_total / .denom, rep(0, dplyr::n())),
    x_min = lag(cumsum(x_width), default = 0),
    x_max = cumsum(x_width)
  ) %>%
  select(-.denom)

df_rect <- df_mosaic %>%
  left_join(df_age_widths, by = "age_bin") %>%
  arrange(age_bin, fsm_bin) %>%
  group_by(age_bin) %>%
  mutate(
    y_min = lag(cumsum(prop_within_age), default = 0),
    y_max = cumsum(prop_within_age),
    label = paste0(
      "n=", n,
      "\n", scales::percent(prop_within_age, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_rect <- df_rect %>%
  mutate(
    x_mid = (x_min + x_max) / 2,
    y_mid = (y_min + y_max) / 2,
    area = (x_max - x_min) * (y_max - y_min)
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 0)

ggplot(df_rect) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = x_min,
      xmax = x_max,
      ymin = y_min,
      ymax = y_max,
      fill = fsm_bin
    ),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    aes(x = x_mid, y = y_mid, label = label),
    seed = 1,
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0.15,
    label.r = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    box.padding = 0.25,
    point.padding = 0.1,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = (df_age_widths$x_min + df_age_widths$x_max) / 2,
    labels = as.character(df_age_widths$age_bin),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mosaic: FSM bins by age bins (area = % of cohort)",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "FibroScan (kPa)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave("Results/Descriptives/Mosaic_FSM_bins_by_age_bins.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#Proportion with fsm > 12.5 by age category
df_final %>%
  mutate(
    age_cat = cut(
      age,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 35, 40, 45, Inf),
      labels = c("Less than 35", "35-39", "40-44", "45 and above"),
      right = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_cat)) %>%
  group_by(age_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_12.5 = mean(fsm > 12.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_20 = mean(fsm > 20, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(prop_12.5, prop_20), names_to = "threshold", values_to = "prop") %>%
  mutate(
     threshold_label = case_when(
        threshold == "prop_12.5" ~ "> 12.5 kPa",
        threshold == "prop_20" ~ "> 20 kPa"
     )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(age_cat, prop, color = threshold_label, group = threshold_label)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = prop - 1.96 * sqrt((prop * (1 - prop)) / n),
      ymax = prop + 1.96 * sqrt((prop * (1 - prop)) / n)
    ),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Age group",
    y = "Proportion with LSM above threshold",
    color = "Liver Stiffness\nMeasurement Threshold"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("Results/Descriptives/Proportion_fsm_over_12.5_by_age_group.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

#Heat plot

df_plot <- df_final %>%

    age_cat = cut(
      age, 
      breaks = c(18, 35, 45, 55, 65, 100), 
      labels = c(
        "18–34",
        "35–44",
        "45–54",
        "55–64",

      ),
      right = FALSE),
    fsm_high = fsm > 12.5
  ) %>%
  group_by(study, age_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    prop = mean(fsm_high, na.rm = TRUE),

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_cat = cut(
      prop,
      breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.35),
      labels = c(
        "0–5%",
        "5–10%",
        "10–15%",
        "15–20%",
        "20–25%",
        "25–30%",
        "30–35%"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    )
  )


ggplot(df_plot, aes(age_cat, study, fill = prop_cat)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_discrete_sequential(
    palette = "Heat",
    name = "Proportion with\nmedian liver stiffness > 12.5 kPa"
  ) +

    x = "Age group",
    y = "Study"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(

  )

```{r}
# define hazardous alcohol (edit threshold to match your definition)
df_long <- df_final %>%
  mutate(
    age_cat = cut(
      age, 
      breaks = c(18, 35, 45, 55, 65, 100), 
      labels = c(
        "18–34",
        "35–44",
        "45–54",
        "55–64",
        "≥65"
      ),
      right = FALSE),
    fsm_high = fsm > 12.5,
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Female", "Male",  "Transgender")),
    hiv = as.character(hiv),
    hbv = as.character(hbv),
    aboriginal = as.character(aboriginal)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Gender = gender,
    Aboriginal = aboriginal,
    HIV = hiv,
    HBV = hbv,
    `Alcohol use` = haz_alc,
    Obesity = obesity
  ) %>%
  # put stratifiers into long form
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Gender, Aboriginal, HIV, HBV, `Alcohol use`, Obesity),
    names_to = "stratifier",
    values_to = "level"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(level))

df_plot <- df_long %>%
  group_by(stratifier, level, age_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    prop = mean(fsm_high, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(fsm_high)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_cat = cut(
      prop,
      breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.35, 1),
      labels = c("0–5%","5–10%","10–15%","15–20%","20–25%","25–30%","30–35%","≥35%"),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    )
    #level = paste0(level, " (n=", n, ")")  # optional: show denominators
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stratifier = factor(stratifier, levels = c("Gender", "Aboriginal", "HIV", "HBV", "Alcohol use", "Obesity"))
  )

ggplot(df_plot, aes(age_cat, level, fill = prop_cat)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ stratifier, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(
    palette = "YlOrRd",
    name = "Proportion with\nmedian liver stiffness > 12.5 kPa"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Age group", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("Results/Descriptives/Heatmap_fsm_over_12.5_by_age_and_stratifier.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
